title: Ownership outside the control plane
stimulus: A thumbnail-generation controller elects a new owner after a pause, but the old owner still has credentials for a shared output store. Design an authority check at the write boundary and state which components must cooperate.
structural_context: Authority validation moved from coordinator to external write boundary.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.

validation.reason: Synthetic design fixture; requires answer-key and source review before real assessment use.
